items.name: Assembly / Machine Code

items.memory_model: Direct hardware register and physical memory addressing
items.runtime_profile: Cycle-accurate bare-metal execution; zero overhead

items.runtime_profile: Extremely fast vector and numerical array math; no pointer aliasing
items.ffi_status: Direct native C ABI interop (ISO_C_BINDING)

children.note: Kemeny & Kurtz simplified Fortran into a beginner interactive language

items.name: Lisp
items.creator: John McCarthy (MIT)
items.memory_model: Automatic Garbage Collection (invented for Lisp)
items.runtime_profile: Interpreted / JIT compiled image-based interactive environment (REPL)

items.game_relevance: The birth of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP): invented classes, subclasses, virtual procedures, and discrete event simulation.
